subject: Difference between Local shiny and shiny-server

messages.author: 526236081e33785b
messages.subject: Difference between Local shiny and shiny-server
parts:
Hi,

I have a Shiny app that works well on a local machine but I am encountering a problem when running it on Shiny-server.  I believe that the issue is due a problem of reading/writing to a temp directory although its tricky to find out where the bug is coming from.  I am looking for any suggestions on how to: 

1: get a better bug level of whats happening in shiny-server that is different from a local shiny app. 
2: any pointers about shiny apps that need to read/write temporary files.  (permissions? set shiny-server temp location?)

I've checked the exact same code with the shiny user on the machine that shiny-server is running on and the code runs fine. So its not libraries - its something shiny-server specific.


Thanks,
zach cp

messages.author: 526236081e33785b
messages.subject: Re: Difference between Local shiny and shiny-server
parts:
To troubleshoot I've checked whether the code runs in the R repl. Looks like my local user runs but the shiny user encounters an error. I believe they are both using the same system libraries but will check that.

Try:

1. rule out the library issue
2. find out where the temp fiels are being written by the library ()
3. try running the app `run-as` out of a home directory and see if that fixes the issue.
